# ledger_bucket_members (Data Source)

The commitments and accounts in one bucket, ordered by object type then identifier. An archived bucket keeps its members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ledger_bucket_members" "fixed_costs" {
  bucket_id = data.ledger_bucket.fixed_costs.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_id` (String) The identifier of the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `added_at` (String) When it was added (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `object_id` (String) The member's identifier.
- `object_type` (String) `commitment` or `account`.
